index.hero.title: Swat Valley
index.hero.lead: A true-to-the-ground illustrated map of Swat: every ridge, river, road and stupa where it really is.
index.hero.caption: Upper Swat seen from the south, heights exaggerated. Drawn from open elevation data.
index.valleys.title: Two valleys, one true map
index.valleys.sub: Each one opens as a map you can fly, tilt and read.
index.do.title: What you can do
index.do.1.title: Explore in golden light
index.do.1.body: Fly over the 3D map at golden hour, then slide the sun to any time of day and watch the ridges cast their shadows.
index.do.2.title: Every place, with its sources
index.do.2.body: Each place has its story, timeline and facts. Every fact is quoted from its source, with a link to read more.
index.do.3.title: Plan a day on the real roads
index.do.3.body: Choose from the places on the map and see the day drawn along the roads. Times follow the road type, paved, jeep or track, and are labelled estimates.
index.do.4.title: Save a valley for offline
index.do.4.body: Download a whole valley once and keep exploring in the mountains, where the signal drops out.
index.time.title: Swat through time
index.time.sub: Six eras, from the grave culture of the middle Swat River to the floods of 2025. Each event links to its source.
index.how.title: Real data sets the facts; AI only paints.
index.how.p1: Terrain, roads, rivers, lakes and places come from open data and sit at their true coordinates. Nothing is ever moved. Artificial intelligence paints the surface on top of that geometry and never decides where anything is. The day planner chooses only among options the app has measured.
index.how.p2: Two exaggerations are allowed, and the map says so: heights are stretched to read as mountains, and landmarks are drawn larger than life. A handful of landmark shapes were generated from Commons photos with an open image-to-3D model (TRELLIS), and the map credits them.
index.how.github: Read the code and the data contract on GitHub

diorama.about.title: How this model is made
diorama.about.p: Every height, the lake outline, the trees' places and the line of the track come from open data. Nothing is moved to look better.
